theorem lg_target {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [LE β] [Zero β] {v₁ : α₁ → β} {v₂ : α₂ → β} : 0 ≤ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ ↔ 0 ≤ v₁ ∧ 0 ≤ v₂ := by
  constructor
  · intros h
    have h₁ : 0 ≤ v₁ := by
      intro x
      exact (le_zero_add (v₁ x)).trans (le_trans (le_zero_add (v₁ x)) h)
    have h₂ : 0 ≤ v₂ := by
      intro x
      exact (le_zero_add (v₂ x)).trans (le_trans (le_zero_add (v₂ x)) h)
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  · intros ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    have h_sum : 0 ≤ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ := by
      intro x
      cases x with a b
      exact le_trans (le_zero_add (v₁ a)) (le_trans (le_zero_add (v₁ a)) h₁)
    exact h_sum
